newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index up as airline halts slump.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index up as airline halts slump.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex gained 0.20 points to 361.13 on Friday as shares of Air Mauritius stopped their two week slump, brokers said.
The volume transacted totalled 5.79 million rupees on 316,746 shares traded from 9.55 million rupees on 259,747 shares traded on Wednesday.
Air Mauritius reversed its recent trend by rising 2.0 rupees to 35.80 rupees on 4,872 shares, brokers said.
Air Mauritius stock price slumped by the maximum permitted six percent during each of the past four consecutive trading sessions, losing 24 percent from 44.30 rupees in two weeks.
"Air Mauritius shares on the market went through a sudden change from a situation of excess supply to one of excess demand on Friday," one broker said.
Another broker added that the sudden change pointed towards a speculative bargain hunting on Air Mauritius shares which had fallen to attractive low levels.
Last week, Air Mauritius Chairman Nash Mallam-Hassam forecast an operating profit of 60 million rupees for the financial year ending 31 March 1997, down from 610 million rupees one year earlier.

Air Mauritius 1996/97 financial figures were expected to be published by 30 June 1997 because listed companies as a statutory requirement have to release their results within three months from the end of their financial year, brokers said.

Among the financials, British American Insurance gained five cents to 8.15 rupees on 100,000 shares, whereas Mauritius Commercial Bank remained at 85.00 rupees on 11,068 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was stable to 11.20 on 123,400 shares.
In the investment sector, most stocks were on the downside.
"There was a lack of buying interest (of investment stocks) especially from foreign investors," one broker said.
But Fincorp Investment gained 50 cents to 72.50 rupees on 1,045 shares. Rogers slipped 1.0 to 99 on 100 shares but Ireland Blyth gained 20 cents to 14.60 rupees on 6,790 shares.

Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert lost 70 cents to 38 rupees on 8,000 shares. In the leisure sector, Automatic System Limited climbed 50 cents to 31.50 rupees on 3,975 shares. Grand Baie Hotel was quoted 45.90 rupees, up 30 cents on 5,584 shares.
New Mauritius Hotels remained to 35.20 rupees on 2,879 shares and Sun Resorts was unchanged to 44.00 rupees.
